findings.probe: Is there a painless black scab or crusted ulcer anywhere on the body, including the groin, armpit or waistline?
findings.topic: a painless black scab (eschar) anywhere on the body, including hidden skin folds

findings.probe: Does the fever come with violent shaking chills followed by drenching sweats, returning at roughly the same time every second day?
findings.topic: shaking chills and drenching sweats that return every second day

findings.probe: Did you wade through flood water, mud or a pond, or handle animals, during or after the trip?
findings.topic: contact with flood water, mud, ponds or animals during the trip

findings.probe: Does the headache sit behind the eyes and get worse when you move your eyes?
findings.topic: pain behind the eyes that worsens on moving the eyes

findings.probe: Has any rash, flushing or red blotching appeared on the skin, even briefly?
findings.topic: any rash, flushing or red blotches on the skin, even brief ones

findings.probe: Are the whites of the eyes red or bloodshot without any discharge or itching?
findings.topic: red, bloodshot eyes without discharge or itching

findings.probe: Are the calf muscles unusually painful or tender to press?
findings.topic: severe pain or tenderness in the calf muscles

findings.probe: Did the fever climb a little higher each day over the first week rather than spiking and falling?
findings.topic: a fever that climbed a little higher each day rather than spiking and falling

findings.probe: Have the bowels been unusually constipated, with the abdomen feeling bloated or distended?
findings.topic: constipation with a bloated or distended abdomen

findings.probe: Are there tender swollen glands in the neck, armpits or groin?
findings.topic: tender swollen glands in the neck, armpits or groin

findings.probe: Were you bitten by mosquitoes mainly during the daytime, indoors or around the house?
findings.topic: mosquito bites mainly during the daytime rather than at night

findings.probe: Did you sit, walk or lie in tall grass, scrub or bushes, or work in fields during the trip?
findings.topic: sitting, walking or working in tall grass, scrub or fields

findings.probe: Is there a cough, or any breathlessness when walking or climbing stairs?
findings.topic: a cough or breathlessness on exertion

findings.probe: Is there a sore throat, a blocked or runny nose?
findings.topic: a sore throat or a blocked, runny nose

findings.probe: Is anyone at home, at work or among your travel companions ill with a similar fever?
findings.topic: other people nearby who are ill with a similar fever

findings.probe: Has there been any bleeding from the gums or nose, or unusual bruising?
findings.topic: bleeding from the gums or nose, or unusual bruising

findings.probe: Has the urine turned dark, like tea or cola?
findings.topic: urine turning dark like tea or cola

findings.probe: Have the eyes or skin turned yellow?
findings.topic: yellowing of the eyes or skin

findings.probe: Has the amount of urine dropped noticeably in the last day?
findings.topic: passing much less urine than usual in the last day

findings.probe: Is there severe or worsening pain in the abdomen, especially on the right side under the ribs?
findings.topic: severe or worsening abdominal pain, especially under the right ribs

findings.probe: Is the vomiting persistent, three or more times in a day, or is it impossible to keep fluids down?
findings.topic: persistent vomiting or being unable to keep fluids down

findings.probe: Did you drink untreated water, or eat cut fruit or food from a roadside stall during the trip?
findings.topic: drinking untreated water or eating roadside food during the trip

findings.probe: Have you had malaria before, or taken any antimalarial tablets recently?
findings.topic: a past episode of malaria or recent antimalarial tablets

findings.probe: Has there been any confusion, unusual drowsiness or difficulty staying awake?
findings.topic: confusion, unusual drowsiness or difficulty staying awake

findings.probe: Did you sleep outdoors, or without a mosquito net, at night during the trip?
findings.topic: sleeping outdoors or without a mosquito net at night
